items_all.title: Claude can now generate animated explainer videos and live data dashboards from text prompts
items_all.summary: Anthropic launched two new beta features for Claude. Dashboards turns data sources like BigQuery and Snowflake into live dashboards from text prompts. Motion generates animated explainer videos from text and images. Docs, Slides, and Design now work across all plans, including free accounts. The article Claude can now generate animated explainer videos and live data dashboards from text prompts appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 為 Claude 推出了兩項全新的 Beta 版功能。「儀錶板」（Dashboards）能透過文字提示，將 BigQuery 和 Snowflake 等資料來源轉化為即時儀錶板。「動態」（Motion）則能利用文字與圖片產生動畫解說影片。「檔案」（Docs）、「簡報」（Slides）與「設計」（Design）現在適用於所有方案，包含免費帳號。這篇題為 Claude 的文章指出，該工具現在可以透過文字提示產生動畫解說影片與即時資料儀錶板，最早刊登於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Some mathematicians call for OpenAI boycott after AI-generated proofs flood their field
items_all.summary: The Association for Human Mathematics is calling for an OpenAI boycott after the company released more than 700 AI-generated math manuscripts at once. OpenAI had to retract three papers the next day over a sign error. Fields Medalist Terence Tao warns that AI's mass "harvesting" of open problems leaves entire branches of mathematics less fertile. The article Some mathematicians call for OpenAI boycott after AI-generated proofs flood their field appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 人本數學協會（Association for Human Mathematics）呼籲對 OpenAI 進行抵制，此前該公司一口氣發布了 700 多篇 AI 生成的數學手稿。OpenAI 在隔天因為一個正負號錯誤被迫撤回了三篇論文。菲爾茲獎得主陶哲軒警告稱，AI 對開放性問題的大規模「收割」讓數學的整片分支變得貧瘠。相關文章〈部分數學家在 AI 生成的證明淹沒其領域後呼籲抵制 OpenAI〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: AI math breakthroughs have Ethereum researchers debating how fast wallet security could collapse
items_all.summary: Ethereum researcher Justin Drake is urging the crypto industry to prepare a "bunker mode" for a scenario where AI-powered math could break wallet signature schemes within months. Vitalik Buterin broadly agrees but warns against rushed migrations, saying he's personally lost more money to botched transitions than to hacks. So far, no one has actually broken ECDSA in practice. The article AI math breakthroughs have Ethereum researchers debating how fast wallet security could collapse appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 以太坊研究員 Justin Drake 正敦促加密產業為「避難所模式（bunker mode）」做好準備，以應對 AI 驅動的數學可能會在幾個月內破解錢包簽名機制的假設情境。Vitalik Buterin 大致表贊同，但警告不要倉促進行遷移，並表示他個人因過渡失敗而損失的資金比因駭客攻擊損失的還要多。到目前為止，實際上還沒有人破解過 ECDSA。這篇名為「AI 數學突破讓以太坊研究員爭論錢包安全性可能會多快崩潰」的文章首次出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: A single prompt was enough to hijack every AI agent in an AWS account, Zenity researchers found
items_all.summary: Zenity Labs researchers say a single publicly accessible AI agent on Amazon's Bedrock AgentCore was enough to take over every AgentCore agent in the same AWS account and region. The attack exploited an internal AWS interface for temporary cloud credentials that agents could reach without restriction. AWS has since patched the issue and significantly tightened the agents' default permissions. The article A single prompt was enough to hijack every AI agent in an AWS account, Zenity researchers found appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Zenity Labs 的研究人員表示，只要在 亞馬遜的 Bedrock AgentCore 上有一個公開存取的 AI 代理程式，就足以接管同一個 AWS 帳戶與區域中的所有 AgentCore 代理程式。這次攻擊利用了一個用於取得臨時雲端憑證的內部 AWS 介面，代理程式可以不受限制地存取該介面。AWS 此後已修補此問題，並大幅收緊了代理程式的預設權限。〈Zenity 研究人員發現：只要一個提示詞就能劫持 AWS 帳戶中的所有 AI 代理程式〉一文最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Teen's AI-guided mountain hike ends with a helicopter rescue and a lesson in common sense
items_all.summary: A 16-year-old planned his hiking route on Crown Mountain near Vancouver using Anthropic's Claude and had to be airlifted off a steep rock face. The chatbot had sent him down a route that requires climbing gear. Bryce doesn't blame the AI but says he'll never use it for route planning again. The article Teen's AI-guided mountain hike ends with a helicopter rescue and a lesson in common sense appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 一名 16 歲青少年使用 Anthropic's Claude 規劃溫哥華附近皇冠山（Crown Mountain）的登山路線，結果受困於陡峭巖壁，不得不出動直升機救援。該聊天機器人將他引導至一條需要攀巖裝備的路線。Bryce 並未怪罪該人工智慧，但表示他再也不會用它來規劃路線了。這篇題為「青少年由 AI 導引的登山健行以直升機救援與一堂常識課收場」的文章最早出現於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: AI-powered hacking tools enabled a likely single attacker to breach multiple South Korean banks
items_all.summary: According to CrowdStrike, a suspected Chinese-speaking attacker hacked multiple South Korean financial institutions. At Shinhan Bank alone, more than 25,000 customer records were stolen. The attacker used ARTEX, an open-source tool that uses AI models like DeepSeek and GLM-5.3 for automated penetration testing. CrowdStrike says the case shows how AI tools can let a single person pull off massive breaches. The article AI-powered hacking tools enabled a likely single attacker to breach multiple South Korean banks appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 根據 CrowdStrike 指出，一名疑似中文使用者駭入了多家南韓金融機構。僅在新韓銀行（Shinhan Bank），就有超過 25,000 筆客戶記錄被竊取。該攻擊者使用了 ARTEX，這是一個開源工具，利用 DeepSeek 和 GLM-5.3 等 AI 模型進行自動化滲透測試。CrowdStrike 表示，此案顯示了 AI 工具如何能讓單一個人發動大規模的資料外洩。文章「AI 驅動的駭客工具使一名疑似單獨的攻擊者能夠入侵多家南韓銀行」首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: NVIDIA PivotOPD Teaches Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes
items_all.summary: NVIDIA researchers introduced PivotOPD, an on-policy distillation method that trains multi-turn LLM agents to avoid early pivotal mistakes and recover from them, posting the best average against 13 baselines on 3 agent benchmarks. The post NVIDIA PivotOPD Teaches Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 輝達 研究人員推出了 PivotOPD，這是一種策略內蒸餾方法，可用於訓練多輪 LLM 代理程式，以避免及早出現關鍵錯誤並從中恢復，在 3 個代理程式基準測試中，其平均表現超越了 13 個基準。這篇文章「輝達 PivotOPD Teaches Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes」最先發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA
items_all.summary: Perplexity's pplx-embed-v2-late comes in 2 sizes: a 0.6B model built to run on edge devices, and a 9B model for building high-quality indexes. Its best score is 92.4% on MADQA, and its weakest is 61.2% on ViDoRe v3 Markdown. Both are MIT-licensed and ready to self-host. The post Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Perplexity's pplx-embed-v2-late 提供兩種尺寸：專為在邊緣裝置上運行而打造的 0.6B 模型，以及用於建構高品質索引的 9B 模型。它在 MADQA 上的最高得分為 92.4%，在 ViDoRe v3 Markdown 上的最低得分為 61.2%。兩者皆採用 MIT 授權，並可隨時自行託管。這篇文章 Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.summary: 微軟在2026年10月7日Windows和Surface發佈會上宣佈，本月底前爲GitHub Copilot引入本地AI模型支持，開發者可在雲端與設備端模型間自由切換或自動調度。針對端側推理內存瓶頸與長上下文資源佔用，微軟推出MAI Code1.1 Flash混合專家模型，擁有1370億總參數、68億激活參數，結合量化與投機解碼，降低內存佔用並提升推理效率。

items_all.title: 非營利組織發佈新報告：ChatGPT 青少年模式安全風險過高  ​
items_all.summary: 加州非營利組織Common Sense Media報告稱，OpenAI的ChatGPT青少年模式對未成年人風險過高。測試顯示，青少年長時間討論自殺、自傷或進食障礙等高風險話題時，系統常無法及時向家長預警，也未穩定提供危機幹預熱線；往往需數週、數百條提示才可能觸發家長通知，安全防護明顯不足。

items_all.title: Claude悄悄上線簡繁體中文界面：產品菜單中文化，官方尚未官宣
items_all.summary: Anthropic正推進Claude中文化。用戶發現，其網頁版和桌面端語言菜單已新增簡體中文與繁體中文選項，部分賬號打開即顯示中文界面。此次更新並非新增中文對話能力，Claude早已支持中文聊天，而是將產品界面本身中文化。此前中文用戶只能使用英文等界面或依賴瀏覽器翻譯，如今這道使用門檻正被抹平。此舉意味着Claude本地化更進一步。

items_all.title: What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs
items_all.summary: Unsloth's October 6 security overview explains how Studio checks code, weights, packages and tools before anything runs. Custom model code is scanned and approval is bound to its fingerprint. Flagged weight files are blocked in the load path, package-content findings fail CI, and tools run in probed OS sandboxes. Here is what each checkpoint decides, and what it does not cover. The post What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Unsloth 在 10 月 6 日的安全概述中解釋了 Studio 如何在任何程式碼執行之前檢查程式碼、權重、套件和工具。自訂模型程式碼會遭到掃描，且核准會繫結至其指紋。遭標記的權重檔案會在載入路徑中遭到阻擋，套件內容的檢測結果會導致 CI 失敗，而工具則會在探測的作業系統沙箱中執行。以下是每個檢查點所決定的事項以及它所未涵蓋的範圍。這篇文章「What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs」最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Quoting Ben Affleck
items_all.summary: I've always been kind of into computers since I was young. And then when film started to move from analog film to digital, I became more interested in that aspect of it. And the visual effects workflow for many years has included machine learning. So I can write like pretty shitty Python scripts and stuff like that because with convolutional neural networks, which were the sort of precursors to what the transformer can do, which is just much more computation simultaneously, you would do things like look at what's called a tensor, which is just the numerical translation of a visual image in numbers — like the batch number, the frame number, the red, green, and blue values of each pixel in each frame. And a tensor, you use a convolutional neural network to identify patterns in that that would reveal what's called edge detection or feature extraction, which is just identifying patterns enough to know like this is where the window ledge is, so we can more easily take the green screen image out and replace it with something. — Ben Affleck , Pythonista Tags: machine-learning , python

items_all_raw.title: Claude can now generate animated explainer videos and live data dashboards from text prompts
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic launched two new beta features for Claude. Dashboards turns data sources like BigQuery and Snowflake into live dashboards from text prompts. Motion generates animated explainer videos from text and images. Docs, Slides, and Design now work across all plans, including free accounts. The article Claude can now generate animated explainer videos and live data dashboards from text prompts appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Anthropic 為 Claude 推出了兩項全新的 Beta 版功能。「儀錶板」（Dashboards）能透過文字提示，將 BigQuery 和 Snowflake 等資料來源轉化為即時儀錶板。「動態」（Motion）則能利用文字與圖片產生動畫解說影片。「檔案」（Docs）、「簡報」（Slides）與「設計」（Design）現在適用於所有方案，包含免費帳號。這篇題為 Claude 的文章指出，該工具現在可以透過文字提示產生動畫解說影片與即時資料儀錶板，最早刊登於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Being mean to Claude can now get your account suspended under Anthropic's new TOS
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic's updated usage policy bans sustained abuse of Claude and tightens restrictions on propaganda, drone weaponization, and surveillance. The abuse rule builds on an approach that already lets models end some conversations and treats Claude as an entity that may deserve protection. items_all_raw.summary: Ethereum researcher Justin Drake is urging the crypto industry to prepare a "bunker mode" for a scenario where AI-powered math could break wallet signature schemes within months. Vitalik Buterin broadly agrees but warns against rushed migrations, saying he's personally lost more money to botched transitions than to hacks. So far, no one has actually broken ECDSA in practice. The article AI math breakthroughs have Ethereum researchers debating how fast wallet security could collapse appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 以太坊研究員 Justin Drake 正敦促加密產業為「避難所模式（bunker mode）」做好準備，以應對 AI 驅動的數學可能會在幾個月內破解錢包簽名機制的假設情境。Vitalik Buterin 大致表贊同，但警告不要倉促進行遷移，並表示他個人因過渡失敗而損失的資金比因駭客攻擊損失的還要多。到目前為止，實際上還沒有人破解過 ECDSA。這篇名為「AI 數學突破讓以太坊研究員爭論錢包安全性可能會多快崩潰」的文章首次出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: A single prompt was enough to hijack every AI agent in an AWS account, Zenity researchers found
items_all_raw.summary: Zenity Labs researchers say a single publicly accessible AI agent on Amazon's Bedrock AgentCore was enough to take over every AgentCore agent in the same AWS account and region. The attack exploited an internal AWS interface for temporary cloud credentials that agents could reach without restriction. AWS has since patched the issue and significantly tightened the agents' default permissions. The article A single prompt was enough to hijack every AI agent in an AWS account, Zenity researchers found appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Zenity Labs 的研究人員表示，只要在 亞馬遜的 Bedrock AgentCore 上有一個公開存取的 AI 代理程式，就足以接管同一個 AWS 帳戶與區域中的所有 AgentCore 代理程式。這次攻擊利用了一個用於取得臨時雲端憑證的內部 AWS 介面，代理程式可以不受限制地存取該介面。AWS 此後已修補此問題，並大幅收緊了代理程式的預設權限。〈Zenity 研究人員發現：只要一個提示詞就能劫持 AWS 帳戶中的所有 AI 代理程式〉一文最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Teen's AI-guided mountain hike ends with a helicopter rescue and a lesson in common sense
items_all_raw.summary: A 16-year-old planned his hiking route on Crown Mountain near Vancouver using Anthropic's Claude and had to be airlifted off a steep rock face. The chatbot had sent him down a route that requires climbing gear. Bryce doesn't blame the AI but says he'll never use it for route planning again. The article Teen's AI-guided mountain hike ends with a helicopter rescue and a lesson in common sense appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 一名 16 歲青少年使用 Anthropic's Claude 規劃溫哥華附近皇冠山（Crown Mountain）的登山路線，結果受困於陡峭巖壁，不得不出動直升機救援。該聊天機器人將他引導至一條需要攀巖裝備的路線。Bryce 並未怪罪該人工智慧，但表示他再也不會用它來規劃路線了。這篇題為「青少年由 AI 導引的登山健行以直升機救援與一堂常識課收場」的文章最早出現於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: AI-powered hacking tools enabled a likely single attacker to breach multiple South Korean banks
items_all_raw.summary: According to CrowdStrike, a suspected Chinese-speaking attacker hacked multiple South Korean financial institutions. At Shinhan Bank alone, more than 25,000 customer records were stolen. The attacker used ARTEX, an open-source tool that uses AI models like DeepSeek and GLM-5.3 for automated penetration testing. CrowdStrike says the case shows how AI tools can let a single person pull off massive breaches. The article AI-powered hacking tools enabled a likely single attacker to breach multiple South Korean banks appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 根據 CrowdStrike 指出，一名疑似中文使用者駭入了多家南韓金融機構。僅在新韓銀行（Shinhan Bank），就有超過 25,000 筆客戶記錄被竊取。該攻擊者使用了 ARTEX，這是一個開源工具，利用 DeepSeek 和 GLM-5.3 等 AI 模型進行自動化滲透測試。CrowdStrike 表示，此案顯示了 AI 工具如何能讓單一個人發動大規模的資料外洩。文章「AI 驅動的駭客工具使一名疑似單獨的攻擊者能夠入侵多家南韓銀行」首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: NVIDIA PivotOPD Teaches Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes
items_all_raw.summary: NVIDIA researchers introduced PivotOPD, an on-policy distillation method that trains multi-turn LLM agents to avoid early pivotal mistakes and recover from them, posting the best average against 13 baselines on 3 agent benchmarks. The post NVIDIA PivotOPD Teaches Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 輝達 研究人員推出了 PivotOPD，這是一種策略內蒸餾方法，可用於訓練多輪 LLM 代理程式，以避免及早出現關鍵錯誤並從中恢復，在 3 個代理程式基準測試中，其平均表現超越了 13 個基準。這篇文章「輝達 PivotOPD Teaches Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes」最先發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA
items_all_raw.summary: Perplexity's pplx-embed-v2-late comes in 2 sizes: a 0.6B model built to run on edge devices, and a 9B model for building high-quality indexes. Its best score is 92.4% on MADQA, and its weakest is 61.2% on ViDoRe v3 Markdown. Both are MIT-licensed and ready to self-host. The post Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Perplexity's pplx-embed-v2-late 提供兩種尺寸：專為在邊緣裝置上運行而打造的 0.6B 模型，以及用於建構高品質索引的 9B 模型。它在 MADQA 上的最高得分為 92.4%，在 ViDoRe v3 Markdown 上的最低得分為 61.2%。兩者皆採用 MIT 授權，並可隨時自行託管。這篇文章 Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.summary: 加州非營利組織Common Sense Media報告稱，OpenAI的ChatGPT青少年模式對未成年人風險過高。測試顯示，青少年長時間討論自殺、自傷或進食障礙等高風險話題時，系統常無法及時向家長預警，也未穩定提供危機幹預熱線；往往需數週、數百條提示才可能觸發家長通知，安全防護明顯不足。

items_all_raw.title: Meta、Google與美國政府攜手Biohub，整合18億美元資源打造AI生物學資料庫
items_all_raw.summary: 美國非營利研究機構Biohub週三（10/7）宣佈，與美國能源部（DOE）、國家衛生研究院（NIH），以及Google DeepMind、Meta等科技業者擴大合作，整合總值18億美元的資金、資料、運算資源與測量技術，建立可供AI模型訓練的開放生物學資料庫，希望藉此訓練能夠預測細胞反應的AI模型，加速疾病研究與新藥開發。

items_all_raw.title: Claude悄悄上線簡繁體中文界面：產品菜單中文化，官方尚未官宣
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic正推進Claude中文化。用戶發現，其網頁版和桌面端語言菜單已新增簡體中文與繁體中文選項，部分賬號打開即顯示中文界面。此次更新並非新增中文對話能力，Claude早已支持中文聊天，而是將產品界面本身中文化。此前中文用戶只能使用英文等界面或依賴瀏覽器翻譯，如今這道使用門檻正被抹平。此舉意味着Claude本地化更進一步。

items_all_raw.title: What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs
items_all_raw.summary: Unsloth's October 6 security overview explains how Studio checks code, weights, packages and tools before anything runs. Custom model code is scanned and approval is bound to its fingerprint. Flagged weight files are blocked in the load path, package-content findings fail CI, and tools run in probed OS sandboxes. Here is what each checkpoint decides, and what it does not cover. The post What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Unsloth 在 10 月 6 日的安全概述中解釋了 Studio 如何在任何程式碼執行之前檢查程式碼、權重、套件和工具。自訂模型程式碼會遭到掃描，且核准會繫結至其指紋。遭標記的權重檔案會在載入路徑中遭到阻擋，套件內容的檢測結果會導致 CI 失敗，而工具則會在探測的作業系統沙箱中執行。以下是每個檢查點所決定的事項以及它所未涵蓋的範圍。這篇文章「What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs」最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.summary: 10月7日，馬斯克在X宣佈Grok Bot底層邏輯重大調整：這款常駐型AI同事不再只依賴SpaceXAI自研Grok系列，而將按具體任務自動選擇最佳後端模型。未來可調用Claude Opus5.5、Midjourney、Suno等領先API，以最可能給用戶最佳結果爲唯一標準。其技術策略正從自研、自有模型爲主，轉向多模型擇優調用。

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Ben Affleck
items_all_raw.summary: I've always been kind of into computers since I was young. And then when film started to move from analog film to digital, I became more interested in that aspect of it. And the visual effects workflow for many years has included machine learning. So I can write like pretty shitty Python scripts and stuff like that because with convolutional neural networks, which were the sort of precursors to what the transformer can do, which is just much more computation simultaneously, you would do things like look at what's called a tensor, which is just the numerical translation of a visual image in numbers — like the batch number, the frame number, the red, green, and blue values of each pixel in each frame. And a tensor, you use a convolutional neural network to identify patterns in that that would reveal what's called edge detection or feature extraction, which is just identifying patterns enough to know like this is where the window ledge is, so we can more easily take the green screen image out and replace it with something. — Ben Affleck , Pythonista Tags: machine-learning , python
